PLANTUML_SECURITY_PROFILE.description: Disable diagram access to local files and remote URLs; keep SANDBOX for this private renderer.

PLANTUML_LIMIT_SIZE.description: Maximum rendered image width or height in pixels. Keep bounded for resource control.

JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS.description: Initial and maximum Java heap. Provision additional memory for the JVM and Graphviz.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for plantuml. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for plantuml. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for plantuml. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
